items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: But George Williams had a nice brass band. Sun Fuquay. Teddy Riley. Wilbur Tillman. Albert Warner. Emmanuel Paul.

ctx.x: Mardi Gras parade. And I finally got back home that night about 9 o'clock. I had blisters on my both feet. So man, I couldn't walk for the next three days. I couldn't walk for the next three days, man. And I said, damn daddy. My daddy sent me 9 years. What the heck am I into now? But George Williams had a nice brass band. Sun Fuquay. Teddy Riley. Wilbur Tillman. Albert Warner. Emmanuel Paul.
Oh man, he had some great players. All-star lineup.
